ipClass.description: Relay node class, empty for any.

sessionId.description: Sticky session id (1-64 alphanumerics); generated if empty.

rotateMinutes.description: Auto-rotate sticky session every N minutes (0 = off).

plaintext.description: allowhttp-1: plaintext HTTP via the exit (exit can read it). Default false.

spendCapCents.description: Stop proxying after this many cents spent in a run (0 = no cap).

controlExtensionIds.description: Extension IDs allowed to send control messages.

controlPageOrigins.description: Origins that get the page control bridge (empty = disabled).

exitCheckUrl.description: https URL returning JSON {ip,country} fetched through the proxy.
